mserp_projectid.meaning: Project identifier the hours are booked to (e.g. PID0000900_007_001)

mserp_category.meaning: Booking category / cost type (e.g. 'A1-P Offshore', 'Non-billable hours')

mserp_activitynumber.meaning: Activity number for the booking line (e.g. A000095814)

mserp_journalid.meaning: Journal/timecard journal id for the booking (e.g. J01164884)

mserp_linenumber.meaning: Line number within the day's timecard

mserp_projectdate.meaning: Project date attributed to the line; can differ from the calendar day it appears under

calendarHeader.status.meaning: Day status: HOLIDAY, SAVED, RELEASED, etc. RELEASED = submitted/frozen

calendarHeader.calendarCode.meaning: Calendar code for the day (HOLIDAY, SAVED, ...)
